effect.name: GM Neon Contour Tubes
effect.desc: Luma-and-alpha contour extraction rendered as layered neon tubes with inner core and soft halo.
effect.shader: float l(vec4 c){return dot(c.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722))+c.a*.5;}float edge(vec2 uv,vec2 d){float c=l(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv));float gx=l(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+vec2(d.x,0),0.0,1.0)))-l(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv-vec2(d.x,0),0.0,1.0)));float gy=l(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+vec2(0,d.y),0.0,1.0)))-l(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv-vec2(0,d.y),0.0,1.0)));return smoothstep(threshold,threshold*2.0,length(vec2(gx,gy))+c*.0);}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);float core=edge(uv,edgeWidthPx/sz),halo=0.0;for(int i=0;i<12;i++){float a=float(i)*.5235988;halo+=edge(clamp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*haloPx/sz,0.0,1.0),edgeWidthPx/sz);}halo/=12.0;vec3 neon=neonColor.rgb*halo*intensity+coreColor.rgb*core*intensity;vec3 result=src.rgb*sourceVisibility+neon;gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,result,mixAmount),max(src.a,clamp((core+halo)*intensity,0.0,1.0)*mixAmount));}
